Leah (CS): quick notes from Solace onboarding — finance asked for a per-route billing export + a short GL mapping doc before their upcoming renewal review.
Omar (PM): please paste exact columns they want so we can scope an MVP.
Leah (CS): requested columns: account_id,project_id,route,route_id,model,requests,tokens,token_cost,currency_code,normalized_cost,period_start,period_end,cost_center,customer_tag. also want a sample row using CAD.
Ruth (Finance): confirm: need `cost_center` mapped to our chart of accounts and an example showing token_cost -> currency -> GL line. procurement will use the sample for approval.
Theo (Engineering): doable. prefer on-demand export first (download button + API), scheduled S3/SFTP later.
Omar (PM): agree. prioritize export as P1 (renewal risk), SFTP = P2, per-team default model = P3.
Leah (CS): they also asked for a small UX change: default model per team so support queues can pick a cheaper generator. not critical for renewal but useful.
Theo (Engineering): MVP plan: endpoint GET /accounts/{id}/billing/exports/{export_id} that returns presigned CSV. sample header we'll add to the ticket. estimate 6 dev-days + 2 QA.
